name: 40208 · Louisville, KY
findings: ZIP 40208 (Louisville) has 102 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40208 (Louisville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
